title: Complete Tianji Record
next_chapter_hook: As the seven rays of light gradually faded, the long-sealed signature on the seventh page slowly emerged—Chen Xuan, the name of Chen Ji's mother. Was she the first master of the Tianji Record, or another Chess Player chosen by fate?

text.content: The moment the Imperial Court's envoy stepped through the Chen Estate's gate, the Turtle Shell artifact pressed against Chen Ji's chest suddenly burned scalding hot, and an ancient rune identical to the one on the gold medallion faintly appeared in the night—higher existence's will had descended upon the mortal realm.

Chen Ji felt as if his chest was being pressed by a branding iron, the Turtle Shell that had accompanied him for years was now vibrating violently, ancient patterns spreading outward at a visible speed, as if something was awakening from slumber. Simultaneously, dozens of miles away at the Demonic Path camp, Ye Qing felt the Demonic Miasma in her embrace beginning to fluctuate intensely.

dialogue.content: This is... Heavenly Fate Resonance? Chen Ji, what are you doing!

text.content: Two forces separated by dozens of miles resonated at the same moment, seven faint light patterns emerging on the Turtle Shell's surface like a long-sealed door slowly opening. Chen Ji inhaled sharply, feeling an unprecedented power surging from the Tianji Record—that was the summoning of its complete form.

At the same moment, a dark shadow quietly appeared behind the Imperial Court's envoy—this was the spy of Tianqing Sect's former Sect Master, Ling Yuan, an undercover agent specifically tasked with monitoring the Chen Estate. He witnessed the strange phenomenon occurring on Chen Ji, and a glint of greed immediately flashed in his eyes.

dialogue.content: (Inner voice) Seven light patterns... will all seven pages of the Tianji Record manifest? The fragment left by Mother, will it finally reveal its complete form?

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the shock in his heart, quickly walking into the inner chamber and tightly closing the doors and windows. The Turtle Shell's temperature in his palm continued to rise, the seven light patterns already shifting from pale gold to dazzling silver-white, a powerful aura emanating from within. The next moment, seven pages glowing with a faint luminescence flew out from the Turtle Shell one by one, gradually unfurling before Chen Ji.

The first page, the general outline handwritten by Chen Xuan, recorded the origin and fundamental laws of the Tianji Record.
The second page, the list of Chess Players through the ages and their fates, with one name crossed out in black—Ling Yuan.
The third page, the current era's world pattern and the flow of fortune, including the Three Great Sects, the Demonic Path, and the Imperial Court.

The fourth page, Chen Ji's own destiny trajectory, clearly showing every choice he made and its price.
The fifth page, prophetic visions of the next three hours, revealing the Imperial Court's envoy's true purpose.
The sixth page, the method to correct and rewrite fate—this was the core ability of the Tianji Record.
And when the seventh page unfurled, Chen Ji was completely stunned. That page contained no prophecies or laws, only a signature, the handwriting graceful and familiar—Chen Xuan, his mother's name.

dialogue.content: Mother... you were actually the first master of the Tianji Record? Then I... what connection does our Chen family have with this artifact?

text.content: Just then, an ancient and majestic voice emerged from the seventh page—that was the will-projection of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, an existence transcending the mundane was gazing at Chen Ji. The core secret of the complete Tianji Record had finally been fully revealed through the resonance of the twin forces of destiny.

dialogue.content: Finally complete, child of the Chen family. The Tianji Record is not an artifact, but a forbidden technique refined by prophets throughout the ages using their own destinies. Your mother was the second holder, and you... are the third. Each Chess Player weaves the chess game of destiny for the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

text.content: Chen Ji's expression slightly changed, but quickly returned to calm. He should have anticipated this—the Tianji Record was never a simple prophetic artifact; each use consumes the Chess Player's Heavenly Fate. And now, the complete Tianji Record showed him an even more terrifying ability.

Fate Writing: not only can it rewrite established facts within the next three hours, but it can also reverse time, rewriting the past that has already occurred. However, each rewriting leaves a rift in the timeline; after more than three times, the timeline will completely collapse, and then the entire world will be destroyed.

dialogue.content: (Inner voice) Is this the true purpose of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets? It doesn't want me to foresee the future, but to use me to rewrite history, making the entire world operate according to its will!

text.content: At the same time, a crucial piece of information emerged on the Tianji Record: a Chess Player's destiny fragments could be reverse-refined to deprive opponents of their power. Cang Yutian, this mysterious figure behind the Imperial Court, his source of power was actually also destiny energy leaked from the Tianji Record.

Chen Ji finally understood—Cang Yutian was not simply human, but the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' first experiment in the mortal realm. He had stolen part of the Tianji Record's power through some forbidden technique, and now existed as a semi-divine being. And the reason he sought the Tianji Record was to complete his own deficiencies.

dialogue.content: Interesting, you actually managed to see through this layer. Indeed, Cang Yutian is my chess piece, just as your mother once was, and as you are now. But I allow you to resist—only in the most intense conflict will the truth of destiny be revealed.

choice.prompt: Facing the pressure of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets and the three major abilities of the complete Tianji Record, Chen Ji must make a choice

choices.description: Directly invoke the Fate Writing ability to gain overwhelming advantage before the final battle, but this will consume precious timeline rewriting attempts
choices.visible_cost: Timeline rift +1, after three rewrites the world collapses
choices.visible_reward: Gain the complete ability to rewrite the past and future, capable of stripping Cang Yutian's power
choices.risk_hint: Each rewrite accelerates the world's destruction, the final battle has a time limit

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, silver light blazing in his palm. Since the Heavenly Dao's Eye wants him as a chess piece, he would completely overturn the chessboard. He began writing the first destiny on the sixth page—Cang Yutian's power source would be stripped. In an instant, Cang Yutian in the distant capital felt a dramatic change, a terrifying force draining from his body

choices.description: Utilize the Tianji Record's foresight ability to find a third path, attempting to defeat Cang Yutian without destroying the timeline
choices.visible_cost: Need more time to strategize, may miss the optimal timing
choices.visible_reward: Unlock hidden route: The true fusion method of the Twin Fates
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian will not give you much time to strategize

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush to use his abilities, but instead frantically deduced various possibilities on the fifth page. A moment later, he discovered another path—Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist and the Tianji Record's resonance could form the 'Twin Fates.' After the fusion of the two forces, a new form beyond the Heavenly Dao's Eye's control would emerge

choices.text: Accept the cost to rewrite history
choices.description: Proactively choose to bear the cost of timeline collapse, completely erasing Cang Yutian from history, but this means abandoning this world
choices.visible_cost: The entire timeline will completely collapse after three rewrites
choices.visible_reward: Completely eliminate Cang Yutian and the Heavenly Dao Will behind him, the world gains freedom
choices.risk_hint: The cost is destruction of everything, including the people you cherish

text.content: A decisive light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. If Heaven wants to destroy me, then I will destroy Heaven. He began writing his own name on the seventh page—this was the final forbidden technique, completely merging his destiny with the Tianji Record, and as a Chess Player, erasing all pieces from the chessboard, including the Heavenly Dao's Eye itself

Just then, Ling Yuan's spies had already transmitted the news of the Chen Manor's anomaly back to the Tianqing Sect. Upon learning the Tianji Record had appeared, the old sect leader immediately felt greedy, secretly gathering forces, preparing to make a move against Chen Ji after the imperial emissaries departed

dialogue.content: The Tianji Record... that divine artifact should have been mine! That woman Chen Xuan, and her useless son, must all die!

text.content: At the same time, the imperial emissaries also sensed that silver light soaring into the heavens. Their expressions shifted slightly, the golden medallion in their hands suddenly emitted dazzling light—that was another artifact of the Heavenly Dao's Eye in the mortal realm, also responding to the Tianji Record's awakening. The two forces converged above the Chen Manor, heaven and earth changing color

Ye Qing sensed the call of destiny dozens of miles away. She immediately set out, turning into a black shadow dashing toward the Chen Manor. She knew the Twin Fates must be present for the Tianji Record to exert its true power. Su Qingyao also received the news at the same moment. Without hesitation, she rushed out of the Inner Sect, heading toward the Chen Manor

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, you useless fool, what the hell are you doing! The entire Tianqing Sect has been startled by your commotion!

text.content: Facing the approaching multifaceted forces, Chen Ji must make a choice under the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye. The complete Tianji Record foretold three endings: First, as a Chess Player, reverse heaven and change destiny, but the cost is bearing heavenly backlash; Second, merge with the Twin Fates, transcend heavenly control, create a new world; Third, completely destroy the Tianji Record, returning everything to nothingness

choice.prompt: Three ending forms have manifested, Chen Ji must choose the destiny he acknowledges

choices.text: The path of reversing heaven and changing destiny
choices.description: As a Chess Player, directly confront the Heavenly Dao's Eye, rewrite its will through destiny writing, but each rewrite consumes massive Heavenly Fate values
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate values drop sharply, possibly leading to death from exhaustion midway

text.content: Chen Ji let out a cold snort, raised his brush, and wrote the first fate on the sixth page—the Heavenly Eye's surveillance over the mortal world would be weakened by thirty percent. Before his words even finished, that ancient voice let out a furious roar, and a majestic pressure surged toward Chen Ji like a tide. "You dare!" The Heavenly Eye was furious; it had never felt a chess piece's rebellion before.

choices.description: Wait for Ye Qing to arrive, perform the Fate Twins resonance with her, transcend Heavenly Dao control, and create a truly own path
choices.visible_cost: Time is needed for waiting, during which one might be besieged by various forces
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the ultimate skill 'Destiny Dance', share fate with Ye Qing, power doubled

text.content: Just as various forces were about to siege the Chen Residence, a black shadow swept across the night sky—it was Ye Qing. Without a word, she stood back to back with Chen Ji, the Demonic Path mist and the power of the Tianji Record clashing in the air. The two rays of light intertwined and gradually merged into a golden-silver pillar of light.

choices.description: Destroy the Tianji Record, return all power to the origin, including the Heavenly Eye, Cang Yutian, and himself, allowing the world to begin anew
choices.visible_cost: Lose all power, perish together with the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: The world gains rebirth, all souls bound by fate shall be liberated
choices.risk_hint: This means your own existence will also vanish

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, gazing at the Tianji Record in his palm, a complex emotion flickering in his eyes. If destroying this divine artifact could exchange for the world's freedom, then he was willing to pay any price. He slowly poured his power into the seventh page, preparing to initiate the ultimate forbidden technique—Return to Nothingness.

Just as the three fates were about to intersect, the seventh page of the Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with dazzling light. The dust-laden signature—Chen Xuan—began to slowly reveal new characters. It was Chen Xuan's final testament left in those days, a segment of deliberately hidden information.

"Ji'er, if you can see these words, it means the Tianji Record has fully awakened. Your mother was the second Chess Player, but after the thirty-second rewriting of fate, I discovered an earth-shattering secret—the Heavenly Eye is not invincible. Its weakness lies within the first page's main text."

dialogue.content: Mother... did you know this day would come long ago? Did you leave these for me to repeat your fate, or... to show me a true path to survival?

text.content: At the same time, the Heavenly Eye's voice rang out again, carrying a trace of mockery: "Your mother was indeed the most outstanding of all Chess Players throughout history. She came close to finding the method to defeat me. Unfortunately, in the end she chose to sacrifice herself and seal the Tianji Record, waiting for the next destined one. And you... will you make the same choice?"

dialogue.content: Or perhaps... will you go further than she did? After all, you carry the bloodline of the Chen Family, and the Chen Family... is precisely the creator of the Tianji Record.

text.content: Upon these words, Chen Ji was struck like by thunder. The creator of the Tianji Record was actually the Chen Family? Then what role did his mother and ancestors play throughout these long years? And was he, Chen Ji, from the very beginning a predestined fate that had been designed? Ling Yuan's name crossed out by the Tianji Record, Han Lie's brute force, Cang Yutian's theft—everything seemed to have an explanation.

The first page's main text slowly unfolded before Chen Ji's eyes. Those words he once thought were merely basic laws now began to reorganize, revealing the hidden true content—"Tianji Record Origin: The Chess Player pays with their own fate as the price, the forbidden technique to seal the Heavenly Eye. All generations of Chess Players are grave keepers, until the Fate Child awakens, only then can this beast be thoroughly sealed."

dialogue.content: (Inner voice) So from the very beginning, the purpose of the Tianji Record's existence was not to let humanity foresee fate, but to seal this monster that peers into the mortal world! Mother knew this, so she chose to sacrifice herself to seal it once. And now... the seal is failing.

text.content: Ye Qing and Su Qingyao arrived simultaneously. They saw the seven pillars of silver light soaring to the heavens and felt the Heavenly Eye's pressure. Ye Qing didn't hesitate, pushing the Demonic Path mist to its extreme, creating a resonance with the Tianji Record on Chen Ji's body. Su Qingyao stood at Chen Ji's side, holding a long sword, coldly scanning the enemies around them.

dialogue.content: You useless trash, you always cause such a huge commotion every time! Tell me, who do you want me to beat up this time?

The twin fates have taken their positions. Chen Ji, it is time to make your choice. The seal on the Eye of Heavenly Secrets will completely fail in another half hour, and then it will fully descend upon the mortal realm.

text.content: Ling Yuan's forces have emerged from the shadows, imperial envoys watch with bated breath, and the projection of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets grows ever clearer. Above all of Chen Manor, a massive vortex of fate has formed, and everyone's gaze focuses on Chen Ji. And at this moment, the Tianji Record in his palm awaits his final decision.

choice.prompt: The seal is about to fail, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets is about to fully descend, Chen Ji must make a decision immediately

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and raised the Tianji Record above his head. Seven rays of light instantly surged, and he began to recite the sealed incantation on the first page. "With my life, seal your eye, reincarnation never ends, the torch passes on!" As the words fell, his body began to dissolve into dots of starlight, merging into the Tianji Record.

text.content: Ye Qing did not hesitate to reach out, clasping fingers with Chen Ji. The two's powers intertwined in the air, the demonic path mist completely merging with the Tianji Record's light, and a power beyond all else erupted from within them. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets let out a terrified howl: "Impossible! How could the twin fates exceed my control!"

choices.visible_cost: The timeline will suffer tremendous shock, potentially causing unpredictable consequences
choices.visible_reward: Completely overturn the order of heaven, grasping fate in one's own hands
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets will not surrender quietly, there will be fierce resistance

text.content: Chen Ji sneered coldly, and wrote the final fate on the seventh page—"From this day forth, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets shall be subject to the chess player's command, all cycles of fate rest within my single thought!" Golden words bloomed across the heavens, and the Eye of Heavenly Secrets let out an earth-shattering roar, its enormous will beginning to waver."}

Just as Chen Ji was about to make his choice, his mother's signature on the seventh page suddenly blazed with dazzling light, and new text emerged from the signature—Chen Xuan's final message left a thousand years ago—"Ji'er, the correct use of the seventh page is neither sealing nor rewriting, but—awakening."}

Awakening? Chen Ji's heart stirred. His mother's signature began to slowly dissipate, replaced by an entirely new law—it turned out the true ability of the Tianji Record was not to foresee or rewrite fate, but to awaken the chess player into the "New Heavenly Way," replacing the current Eye of Heavenly Secrets. This was the true secret the Chen family had guarded for generations.

dialogue.content: No! This is impossible! Chen Xuan clearly chose sealing, she did not pass down this secret!

(Cold laugh) Do you really think my mother was that foolish? She knew sealing only treated the symptoms, not the root cause, so she set up double insurance on the seventh page—if descendants do not choose sealing, the awakening clause will trigger. And the trigger condition is both twin fates being present.

text.content: Ye Qing and Su Qingyao stood simultaneously on both sides of Chen Ji, their fates having long been intertwined with the Tianji Record. Ling Yuan's forces lurked menacingly in the distance, the imperial envoys wore grim expressions, and the projection of the Heavenly Dao's Eye grew increasingly faint—it knew that the true crisis had arrived.

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, immersing his entire consciousness into the Tianji Record. He felt the power his mother had left behind, sensed the will of the Chen family's ancestors through generations, and perceived the threads of fate governing the entire world. In this moment, he was no longer thetrash disciple, but the true Son of Destiny.

"Awaken, Tianji Record. Awaken, my destiny!" Chen Ji's voice echoed through the Void, and seven rays of light instantly blazed with fury, transforming into a pillar of light that pierced through heaven and earth. The Heavenly Dao's Eye let out a final roar, and then—completely dissipated. A new Heavenly Dao Will was being born, and its name was Chen Ji.

Just as the seven rays of light gradually faded, the long-sealed signature on the seventh page slowly emerged—Chen Xuan, his mother's name. Her handwriting remained elegant, but beside the signature, a new line of smaller characters appeared: "Ji'er, awakening is not the end, but a new beginning. The true test has just begun."

dialogue.content: (Inner voice) Mother, you indeed left a backup plan. But it doesn't matter—I will uncover all the truths. No matter how many secrets this world still holds for me, I will reveal them one by one.

text.content: When Ling Yuan witnessed this scene from afar, his face turned ashen. The Tianji Record he had schemed for hundreds of years had fallen into Chen Ji's hands. The imperial envoy knelt on the ground, feeling an entirely new power surpassing everything taking control of this world. Under the sky of Tianqing Sect, everyone knew—a new era had begun.
